items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: Bo said, we in Moikin. And all them boys in the band, they like that too.

ctx.x: Billy do me so good sometimes, when I see them boys having fun like that.

Sometimes I'm sorry when it's over. Yeah. You know, I'll be enjoying myself. Sure. I'll be enjoying myself just like it's me down there. Smeet Army. Bo said, we in Moikin. And all them boys in the band, they like that too. See, that's what makes a band.
